The '''''Galactic Princess''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Oobolo]] in [[44 ABY]]. Oobolo ran a gambling operation on board the ship as a cover for [[Gender/Legends|his]] criminal activity.
